overview_description.description: One Month teaches beginners to code HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python. It tells about how learning to code is starting and motivation, so it designed courses for true beginners. Its computer programming courses launch side hustles, level up careers, and build things it couldn’t even imagine before. Its courses combine video tutorials, human support, and the opportunity to create real-world projects from day one.

product.description: A course designed to advance learners from SQL beginner to intermediate proficiency over a set period.
